consumer: game::npc_menu, reached when the avatar moves/bumps into a tile occupied by an NPC, which builds a uilist of Talk/Swap/Push/etc. and calls amenu.query() to ask the player which interaction to perform
scope: the single friendly NPC occupying the destination tile and the interactive menu of actions offered for it
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu builds a uilist amenu (Talk, Swap positions, Push away, ...) and calls amenu.query(), then branches on amenu.ret -- an interactive menu answered through the real input loop, not a computed value or raw state
divergence: avatar steps into a tile holding a friendly NPC: a correct answer raises the npc_menu and routes the player's choice (e.g. Swap positions) through the engine; a wrong answer that treats it like the wall no-op (silently does nothing) or auto-picks a default option (e.g. silently attacks/swaps) diverges from what the real menu-driven interaction would produce
